📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-05-rainforest-outbound-api-p95-latency`
This is occurrence #11 (last notified 2026-07-24T11:25:00Z, ~72h ago — exceeded the 24h suppression window).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Transactions`
Playbook: outbound HTTP calls from runtime-core-api to api.rainforestpay.com intermittently breach 3s p95, self-recovering, third-party latency (not a Method-side defect); confirm via dd_search.py metric on peer.hostname:api.rainforestpay.com, confirm 0 errors on runtime-core-api.
Open Jira: n/a — fix_jira not set
